test_item:
The Cert Provider feature shall operate within the following resource and performance constraints:
(resource usage stays within the estimated limits during repeated verification)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. Test runner CertProviderAndroidInstrumentalTest.apk is installed
3. Certificate assets are available under SecurityAssets/oem-certs/cert-provider/
proc:
1. Run the Cert Provider instrumentation test for fotaMcpuCertVerifyStressTest
$ adb shell am instrument -w -e class com.mitsubishielectric.ahu.efw.lib.melcocertprovider.libcertproviderservice.test.CertProviderServiceManagerTest#fotaMcpuCertVerifyStressTest com.mitsubishielectric.ahu.efw.lib.melcocertprovider.libcertproviderservice.test/androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner
2. Read the process resource usage on the DUT
$ adb shell procrank
er:
1. The instrumentation runner reports "OK (1 test)" for fotaMcpuCertVerifyStressTest
2. The adb shell procrank output shows the Cert Provider RAM usage within the stated limit
